[[Hierophant Morlog]] is endeavoring to learn the true name of the [[Great Destroyer]] and bring about a calamity to the world.

He is currently exploring the ruins of [[the Stone Basilica]] for the [[Tome of the Rubicon]] with a group of [[Summit Taskmaster]]s. The Tome is said to contain the name of the Great Destroyer.
